name: critical_decisions_v1
objective: Build intervention-labeled motion-scene decisions with executable alternatives and a BFM-compatible evidence contract.

teacher.selection_rule: Audit an available tracking teacher on the selected motion families and freeze the compatible robot, action, history and decoder contracts before qualification.

sources.ancestry_split_requirement: Original performance, actor/session when identifiable, mirror, resample, retarget and scene descendants remain grouped. Existing pilot test groups are development-only for this follow-up until a fresh evaluation split is frozen.

selection.family_selection_rule: Use two families with demonstrated teacher execution support; do not claim coverage of the others.

execution_budget.unqualified_pair_behavior: Retain failed attempts and do not promote the pair; do not silently replace failures to fill a success quota.
execution_budget.preflight_scope: Any runtime preflight outside the 480-attempt study must be separately bounded and logged before launch.

representation_contract.motion_codes: Temporal motion representation; not native motor tokens.
representation_contract.scene_tokens: Metric 3D object/set tokens with frames, visibility, padding and unknown-space semantics.
representation_contract.relation_labels: Verified motion-scene body-part/time/behavior relations; future-derived values are training-only.
representation_contract.motor_tokens: Native controller representation pinned to teacher decoder and action conventions.
representation_contract.adapter: Required and separately validated whenever a motion representation drives a different motor-token space.

execution_progress.remaining: Isolate token-boundary discontinuity versus leg reconstruction; establish more teacher-supported independent carriers; replicate overhead traversal across sources; evaluate learned proposer and downstream scene-first student utility.
